in_sanskrit.name: मनस्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Manas is derived from the root man meaning 'to think'. It refers to the mind, intellect, or thought. In Hinduism, Manas is considered as one of the five components of the human self, along with Buddhi (intellect), Ahamkara (ego), Chitta (consciousness), and Ahankara (personality).

in_hindi.name: मनास
in_hindi.long_meaning: Manas is derived from the Sanskrit word मनस् (manas). In Hindi, it is transliterated as मनास (manās). It holds the same meaning as in Sanskrit, i.e., mind, intellect, or thought.

in_tamil.name: மனம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Manam is the Tamil transliteration of the Sanskrit word मनस् (manas). It holds the same meaning in Tamil as in Sanskrit, i.e., mind, intellect, or thought.
